fixture.label: Original upstream deterministic fixture; shared between routes, no model inference or independent gold

instrumentation.native_http: Read-only global fetch wrapper in original bridge child; no replacement transport, request mutation, correlation header, injected faults or delays
instrumentation.overhead: Wrapper stamps and hashes, clones response bodies asynchronously, and appends native records synchronously. Scheduling, memory and file-I/O overhead is measured as part of elapsed time; no uninstrumented latency claim.
instrumentation.raw_mcp: Exact application JSON-RPC bytes on genuine loopback HTTP or child-process stdio, with paired matching IDs
instrumentation.native_bytes: Fetch-visible request input and response entity body, not TLS/TCP framing or implicit HTTP request headers

namespaces.task: AmirK-S bridge opaque tk_ MCP task handle; native task ID is not revealed by this projection
namespaces.context: AmirK-S bridge opaque cx_ context handle; native context ID is private sidecar data
namespaces.principal: unidentified unauthenticated local development caller; no authority grant inferred
namespaces.validity_interval: not established; no service freshness lease inferred
